acceptance_matrix.observable_result: All 646,053 core and people registry records have a resolver version, complete bounded candidate vectors, evidence classes, confidence semantics, explicit decision rule, input and output states, and deterministic replay identity. Exactly 641,384 proof-backed decisions remain selected. Alias, name, context, and bounded fuzzy evidence rank candidates only; name-only and probability-based promotions are both zero.

The declared repository output is a 5,995-byte Parquet pointer to the complete 171,445,108-byte content-addressed external Parquet payload. The pointer pins SHA-256, byte count, 646,053 rows, 38 columns, schema identity, eligibility, and a fail-closed consumer contract. Independent validation parsed every row, recomputed every resolution-record hash, and rejected all seven unsafe pointer mutations.

The work preserves 2,964 candidate-generated, 991 review-required, and 714 unresolved decisions; 708 records have no supported candidate. It makes no source-availability, calibrated-confidence, PIT, model, protected-performance, or operational-readiness claim, uses no target-game outcomes, and preserves the failed first schema-identity validation as a negative finding.
